Types

Xxh3Kind = enum
  xxh3_64, xxh3_128
Xxh3State = object
Streaming XXH3 state. Buffers input and hashes it at digest time, so results match the one-shot form for any chunking. 
Xxh32State = object
Xxh64State = object
Xxh128 = object
  lo*: uint64
  hi*: uint64
128-bit XXH3 result: lower and higher 64-bit halves.
